Prereqs exist; stage abstract-reasoning >= hard prereq concrete-operations.

Gap real (no general MB=MC topic; cost-benefit-analysis-health is program CBA). Worked Q1: net gains +5,+3,+1,-1 so 3 hours (index 1) correct; Q2 sunk cost: 1.5M > 1M so finish, +0.5M correct. Prereqs and builds-toward exist; stage formal-systems = hard prereq stage.

Reworked all numbers: autarky P=50; at Pw=20 Qd=80, Qs=20, M=60; at 30 Qd=70, Qs=30, M=40; revenue 400; CS loss 750; PS gain 250; DWL 100 = 50+50; quota of 40 gives P=30. Q1 (index 2=40) and Q2 (index 1=100) correct. Hard prereqs max formal-systems = stage.

Gap real (no econ topic on benefits/ability-to-pay, vertical/horizontal equity, lump-sum tax; tax-brackets-marginal-rates is a practical-life-skills bracket topic). Q1: 2,000+9,000=11,000, avg 22%, marginal 30% correct. Linear DWL = 1/2 t dQ with dQ proportional to t, so DWL grows with t^2 (doubling quadruples) correct. Capped payroll tax regressive above cap correct. Matches Mankiw ch. 12 framing (benefits principle gas-tax example). Prereqs/builds-toward exist; stage ok.

Gap real ("certainty equivalent" appears nowhere else in domains/; no EU/risk-aversion topic). sqrt example: EU=5, sqrt(50)=7.07, CE=25, RP=25 correct; Q1 index 1 ($25) correct. Max insurance WTP = expected loss + risk premium correct; accept gamble iff expected gain > risk premium correct. Bernoulli 1738 St Petersburg, vNM axioms, Arrow-Pratt -u''/u' confirmed (Wikipedia expected utility hypothesis; Pratt 1964). expected-value (math) formal-systems = stage.

Gap real in economics (history-of-banking and banking-services-and-development mention runs; no Diamond-Dybvig/LOLR theory topic). Q1 balance sheet: 10 reserves + 30 from selling 50 face at 0.6 = loss 20 > equity 8, insolvent; correct. Diamond-Dybvig 1983, 2022 Nobel with Bernanke, Banking Act of 1933 created FDIC, $250,000 per depositor per bank per ownership category, Bagehot Lombard Street 1873, SVB ~$42B outflow 9 Mar 2023 with 86-94% uninsured deposits (Wikipedia Collapse of SVB; CNBC; Fortune). Stage formal-systems = hard prereq.

Gap real (no other topic covers Hall's martingale result; lifecycle topic only names excess sensitivity). Derivation checked: u'=1-aC with r=rho gives E_t C_{t+1}=C_t; Q2 index 1 correct. Hall 1978, lagged stock prices predictive, Flavin 1981 excess sensitivity, Campbell-Mankiw 1989 lambda about 0.5 confirmed (Campbell-Mankiw PDF scholar.harvard.edu; LSE/UH lecture notes). Wrong: "utility more curved than quadratic" is what triggers precautionary saving; the property is convex marginal utility (u'''>0), not curvature; reworded.

Gap real (savings-constraints-development discusses buffer stocks in development context but not prudence/u'''/certainty equivalence). Log example: 0.5(1/50+1/150)=0.01333 vs 0.01 correct; Q1 index 1, Q3 index 2 correct. Log u'''=2/C^3>0; quadratic u'''=0; Kimball 1990 prudence -u'''/u''; Deaton and Carroll buffer-stock models confirmed (standard; Romer ch. 8). Stage expert = euler-equation-consumption.

Gap real (stationarity topics only name cointegration). Engle-Granger 1987 Econometrica 55(2):251-276 with representation theorem and two-step method confirmed (econometricsociety.org); 2003 Nobel (Granger for common trends/cointegration); EG critical values more negative; OLS superconsistency; ECM delta=-0.25 closes ~1/4 of gap; Johansen VECM. Wrong: Q1 explanation said high R2 "occurs for any pair of I(1) series"; true only of stationary differences; reworded to "often appears even between unrelated random walks".

Gap real (order/rank condition appears only here; 2SLS topic mentions simultaneity once). Order condition, rank condition (Wooldridge two-equation form), rain identifies demand / income identifies supply, Q2 (2 endogenous vs 1 excluded = underidentified) correct. Working 1927 QJE 41(2):212-235 and Haavelmo 1943 Econometrica 11(1) confirmed (RePEc, Wikipedia). Hard prereqs formal-systems = stage.

Gap real (Tobit appears nowhere else). Tobin 1958 Econometrica 26(1):24-36, durable-goods spending confirmed (Wikipedia Tobit model; Amemiya 1984 survey). Derived dE(y|x)/dx_j = beta_j Phi(z): d/dx of Phi(z)xb + sigma phi(z) gives beta_j[Phi + z phi - z phi]; 80 x 0.6 = 48, Q1 index 1 correct. Likelihood pieces 1-Phi(xb/sigma) and (1/sigma)phi((y-xb)/sigma) correct. Wrong: Q4 answer said top-coded data use "the same likelihood"; top-coding is right-censoring at a threshold c so the censored term differs; reworded to "a likelihood of the same form ... censoring point and direction adjusted".

Gap real (selection-bias-econometrics and labor topics only name Heckman). Heckman 1979 Econometrica 47(1):153-162, two-step estimator confirmed (econometricsociety.org); 2000 Nobel for analyzing selective samples. E(y|x,s=1)=xb+rho sigma lambda(zg), lambda=phi/Phi (Q3 index 1), coefficient on lambda-hat = rho sigma, generated-regressor SE adjustment, near-linearity of lambda without exclusion restriction, kids<6 exclusion (Wooldridge Mroz example), Q4 slope-flattening logic all correct. Stage advanced = logit-probit-models.

Gap real (impact/long-run propensity appear nowhere else; time-series-basics has no lags). Worked: temporary shock path 0.5, 0.3, 0.1, 0 (Q1 index 2 correct); LRP 0.9 (Q2 index 2); permanent path 0.5, 0.8, 0.9; reparameterization theta z_t + d1(z_{t-1}-z_t) + d2(z_{t-2}-z_t) algebra verified. Matches Wooldridge ch. 10 definitions and fertility/tax example. Stage formal-systems = hard prereqs.

Gap real (WACC topic uses tax shield but no topic teaches MM I/II, homemade leverage, tradeoff/pecking order). Q1: 10% + 1 x 5% = 15%, WACC 0.5x15+0.5x5 = 10% correct (index 2). Tax shield PV tau_c r_D D / r_D = tau_c D, MM 1963 V_L = V_U + tau_c D (Q3 index 1). MM 1958, Myers-Majluf 1984, Modigliani Nobel 1985, Miller 1990 correct (Berk-DeMarzo framing; Nobel citations). Stage advanced = WACC. Style: "leverage" kept; it is the finance term (debt financing), not the banned buzzword.

Gale-Shapley 1962 AMM title, proposer-optimal/receiver-pessimal, strategy-proof for proposers (Dubins-Freedman; Roth 1982), no mechanism stable and strategy-proof for both sides (Roth 1982), NRMP applicant-proposing Roth-Peranson redesign, NYC school choice, 2012 Nobel Roth-Shapley confirmed (plus.maths.org; UC news; arXiv 2103.11458). All prereqs soft; stage advanced plausible.

Samuelson 1954 "Pure Theory of Public Expenditure" REStat, Lindahl 1919 personalized prices confirmed (Wikipedia Erik Lindahl; Walker lecture notes u.arizona.edu); VCG not budget balanced. Stage expert = pareto-efficiency-and-optimality.

Derivation dK/K = s(Y/K) - delta = s/v - delta checked; Q1 0.20/4 = 5% (index 1); Q2 0.07x3 = 21%, gap 6% (index 0). Harrod 1939, Domar 1946, Rostow 1960 take-off, Solow 1956, Easterly "Ghost of Financing Gap" (WB WP 1807 1997, JDE 1999) confirmed (RePEc, econbiz). Stage advanced >= formal-systems hard prereq.
